lines.text: Many learners say: I was born on 1995.

native.tip: Kita bilang “lahir pada tahun 1995” dengan pada. Di bahasa Inggris, untuk tahun pakai in, bukan on.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “I was born on 1995.” 😅 Untuk tahun, pakai in: “I was born in 1995.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “in”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “I was born in 1995.” lalu tulis tahun lahirmu dengan born in. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “lahir pada tahun 1995” with pada. In English, for a year use in, not on.
en.caption: Ever say this? “I was born on 1995.” 😅 For a year, use in: “I was born in 1995.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
